update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.31 - Support card selection optimizations
Improvements --- - Scroll-list picker OCR runs once per row (bbox dedupe keys instead of double OCR) - List rows use 1.5× OCR scale; slot labels stay at 2× for accuracy - Borrow slot matching respects preferred-card priority order - Borrow scroll fallback scans the list once for all preferred names - Owned deck equip batches slot OCR and refreshes only changed slots after picker - Friend-slot skip requires top preferred match when borrow rotation is off - Shorter post-tap waits on support picker taps (0.6s)
Includes v5.9.30 cold start fix and prior parent-farming updates.
